en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view from the main gate of the Alba Carolina Citadel over the town of Alba Iulia. In the foreground is a stone statue figure; at right stands a tall obelisk with reliefs and a stepped base (the Horea, Cloșca și Crișan Obelisk). The reverse has Romanian printed headings and handwriting, a 40 BANI imprint, and postal cancellations.
